findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "cancellation_help" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_premium, compare_household, subsidy_info · Private data: insurer_facts, find_help · Public sink: compare_household.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_premium, compare_household, subsidy_info · Private data: insurer_facts, find_help · Public sink: compare_household

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
